cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Here's the finished budget report. Just the title page: I've left room for contributions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The board meets in ten minutes. They need your figures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. It's the discussion edition. They can supply their figures directly, without reading mine first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The chair wants a recommendation, not a discussion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll add 'Approve' beneath the title. Finished decision edition. We've eliminated the discussion entirely.

mechanism: A treats a pupil demand for missing report substance as an opportunity to explain why its incomplete work is a finished learning format.
confusable: Not just bluffing expertise: A specifically labels the absent figures or minimal recommendation as deliberate completion.
comparison: Uninstalled cupboard as teaching material versus title-only budget as participatory decision document.
seedUse: Keep D41 title page/board figures/recommendation/Approve chain; S05 participatory lesson supplies A justification.
